subject: general
question:
If a solid sphere of radius 14 cm is moulded into 8 spherical solid balls of equal radius, then find the surface area of each ball.

 ({Use } pi = (22)/(7))
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume conserved ⇒ R³ = 8r³ ⇒ r = R/2 = 7 cm

Surface area = 4πr² = 4 × (22/7) × 7²

= 4 × (22/7) × 49 = 616 cm²

**∴ Answer = 616 cm²**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of big sphere = 14 cm, number of small spheres = 8

**Formula used:**

Volume of sphere = (4/3)πr³, Surface area = 4πr²

**Calculation:**

⇒ Volume conserved:

(4/3)π(14)³ = 8 × (4/3)πr³

⇒ 14³ = 8r³

⇒ r³ = 14³ / 8 = (14/2)³ = 7³

⇒ r = 7 cm

⇒ Surface area = 4πr² = 4 × (22/7) × 49

⇒ = 616 cm²

**∴ The surface area of each ball is 616 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume Conservation

When reshaped, total volume remains same.

Scaling Rule

If number of spheres = n, radius scales as R / n¹/³.

Surface Area

4πr²

π Value

Use 22/7 as given.
